lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular spots are arranged in a structured grid pattern across the flank. Posterior to the gill region, at least three horizontal rows of blobs are visible, aligned in vertical columns to form a regular lattice of local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, intersecting with horizontal rows of spots. The circular high-luminance blobs are positioned at the nodes where these vertical bands cross the longitudinal carinae.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible. Each ridge displays a sharp vertical intensity gradient, with high-luminance pixels on the superior edge and deep shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of smaller, high-luminance blobs. Near the proximal base of this fin, there are faint, irregular white vermiculations that differ from the circular spot pattern on the main flank.
